using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class ClusterConfigTests
    {
        private ClusterConfig CreateClusterConfigWithLocalNode(string localNodeId, long configEpoch, string localNodeIp = "127.0.0.1", int localNodePort = 1234)
        {
            var config = new ClusterConfig();
            config = config.InitializeLocalWorker(
                localNodeId,
                localNodeIp,
                localNodePort,
                configEpoch,
                NodeRole.PRIMARY,
                null,
                "localhost");
            return config;
        }

        [Fact]
        public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_NoCollision_ReturnsSameConfig()
        {
            var localNodeId = "node1";
            var localConfigEpoch = 1L;
            var senderConfigEpoch = 2L;

            var localConfig = CreateClusterConfigWithLocalNode(localNodeId, localConfigEpoch);
            var senderConfig = CreateClusterConfigWithLocalNode("node2", senderConfigEpoch);

            var result = localConfig.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, null);

            Assert.Same(localConfig, result);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_SenderNodeIdLessOrEqualLocal_ReturnsSameConfig()
        {
            var localNodeId = "node2";
            var localConfigEpoch = 1L;

            var localConfig = CreateClusterConfigWithLocalNode(localNodeId, localConfigEpoch);
            var senderConfig = CreateClusterConfigWithLocalNode("node1", localConfigEpoch);

            // senderNodeId < localNodeId
            var result1 = localConfig.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, null);
            Assert.Same(localConfig, result1);

            // senderNodeId == localNodeId
            senderConfig = CreateClusterConfigWithLocalNode(localNodeId, localConfigEpoch);
            var result2 = localConfig.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, null);
            Assert.NotSame(localConfig, result2); // Because senderNodeId == localNodeId triggers bump and log
        }

        [Fact]
        public void HandleConfigEpochCollision_EpochCollision_LogsWarningAndBumpsEpoch()
        {
            var localNodeId = "node1";
            var localConfigEpoch = 1L;

            var localConfig = CreateClusterConfigWithLocalNode(localNodeId, localConfigEpoch);
            var senderConfig = CreateClusterConfigWithLocalNode("node2", localConfigEpoch);

            var logger = new TestLogger();

            var result = localConfig.HandleConfigEpochCollision(senderConfig, logger);

            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.NotSame(localConfig, result);
            Assert.Single(logger.Warnings);
            var warning = logger.Warnings[0];
            Assert.Contains("Epoch Collision", warning);
            Assert.Contains(localConfigEpoch.ToString(), warning);
            Assert.Contains(localNodeId, warning);
            Assert.Contains(senderConfig.LocalNodeId, warning);
        }

        private class TestLogger : ILogger
        {
            public readonly System.Collections.Generic.List<string> Warnings = new();

            public IDisposable BeginScope<TState>(TState state) => null;

            public bool IsEnabled(LogLevel logLevel) => logLevel == LogLevel.Warning;

            public void Log<TState>(LogLevel logLevel, EventId eventId, TState state, Exception exception, Func<TState, Exception, string> formatter)
            {
                if (logLevel == LogLevel.Warning)
                {
                    Warnings.Add(formatter(state, exception));
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
